trainable: LoRA adapters · base DreamZero-AgiBot DiT/VAE/umt5 frozen

Layout follows DreamZero (GEAR) joint video-action figure; ALOHA/LeKiwi is the target embodiment via LoRA from DreamZero-AgiBot. Frames are eval-viz rollouts (cond / Wan-pred) — trainable signal is LeRobot state-action, not mp4.
